personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical command center that prioritizes glanceable metrics, immediate hierarchy, and durable utility for construction field operations.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

dont's: No glassmorphism per Dark-First Utility constraints on dense data screens. Use solid surfaceSecondary instead.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login, registration, and biometric access with 'pending admin approval' states.

states.error: Standard alert or inline red warning text.

screens.layout: Hero logo area (initials 'BZ' with brand tint until PNG provided), inputs for email/PIN. Single column, large touch targets. Submit button sticky at bottom in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Role-specific operational surface showing today's progress, open tasks, and metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the card sizes.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty site with 'No active projects today'.

screens.layout: Top app bar with project selector and avatar. Hero summary strip (Today's progress/open issues) using condensed typography for numbers. 4-column metrics grid for quick stats. Stacked cards for recent activities or issues below. Use dark gray surfaces with orange accents for critical alerts.

screens.name: Daily Report
screens.purpose: Single-purpose screen for capturing voice notes, generating transcripts, and attaching photos.

states.empty: N/A - form is always ready to accept input.
states.error: Red inline text if voice recognition fails or upload fails.

screens.layout: Vertical column form. Top bar with project/date. Primary action area with a large 'Record Voice Note' button. Live transcript review panel below it. Photo attachment strip (horizontal scroll). Sticky 'Submit Report' CTA pinned to the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Time Tracker & Calendar
screens.purpose: Review own hours or approve worker hours (Foreman/Admin).

states.empty: 'No logged hours this week' message with icon.
states.error: 'Failed to sync hours' with a retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky weekly calendar strip at top. List view of daily hour logs below. Each row shows worker name/avatar, hours worked, and extra hours. Approval toggle on the right side for Foremen. Bold condensed fonts for hour numbers.

screens.name: Projects & Notices
screens.purpose: CRUD project views, viewing project details and managing delivery notices/PDFs.
screens.layout: List of project cards featuring thumbnail photos (construction site). Clicking a project opens detail view with tabs: Overview, Issues, Notices, Reports. Delivery notices use a compact row layout with a PDF/attachment icon indicator.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT Dark-First Utility DARK design system: NO pure black for surfaces (#121212 base), sharp typography (Barlow Condensed for metrics, DM Sans for UI).
NO glassmorphism. Use solid `#1A1A1A` and `#262626` for depth per Utility constraints.
BISON LOGO FALLBACK: Use a brand-tinted square container with the text initials 'BZ' sized to fill the container at weight 500, until the real PNG logo is provided.
ALL SCREENS must have Loading, Empty, and Error states clearly defined and taking flex: 1.
DAILY REPORT screen must be optimized for field work: large touch targets for the Voice Note record button, horizontal strip for photos, and a sticky Submit button placed at the bottom.
STICKY CTAs: The primary action button (Save, Submit, Start) must be fixed at the bottom of the screen (inside a padded fixed container) so it never scrolls out of view.
CURRENCY FORMATTING: Hardcode formatting logic or provide helper to display as '1,2 tys. €'.
IMAGE SCRIM: Whenever text sits on a thumbnail or hero photo, apply the vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
Use Phosphor icons with filled/outlined state distinction for active/inactive tabs.
Add tactile feedback (haptics) on critical interactions: submitting a report, starting/stopping voice note, changing tabs, approving hours.
